name: Royal River Casino RV Park
note: Flandreau Santee Sioux Tribe casino's RV lot: a separate paved lot of angled back-in sites on a central median across the road south of the casino; check in and collect keys at the hotel front desk, and RV guests use the hotel's showers, laundry and pool. 28-day maximum stay. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator page royalrivercasino.com/entertainment/rv-lot-spring-summer-specials (live, read 2026-11-22): '21 RV back-in sites ... All sites include full hookups ... 20/30/50 amp spots ... Picnic tables ... 28-Day maximum stay limit ... May 1-Sept 30: $35 + tax Sunday-Thursday | $45 + tax Friday-Saturday', check in at the hotel front desk; Wayback 2026-01-23 capture of the Fall/Winter page: 'October 1-April 30: $25 + tax Sunday-Thursday | $35 + tax Friday-Saturday'. Esri imagery (2026-11-22) shows a purpose-built paved lot with angled back-in stalls along a central median, separate from the casino's customer parking (across the road to the south) - a developed full-hookup RV park, not an overnight parking allowance (Dakota Sioux 14583 / Prairie Knights 5948 / Shooting Star 14620 precedent). Private price gate: cheapest RV night $25 (fall/winter weeknight), $35 summer weeknight, $45 summer weekend peak -> passes US$50 with no gateway needed (gateways.py: none within 40 km). Presence: working operator website with rates and phone. Long-stay tests: nightly rates posted, 28-day maximum stay, no minimum -> pass. Reviews: Google 3.9 over 2,178 is the shared casino+hotel listing (not the RV park's alone); RV Life 2*/$ (avg $12, stale) over only 7 reviews -> no review-count drop. Not in the DB: no SD entry named Royal River; nearest entry 5861 Flandreau City Park ~3 km NE.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World Imagery at 44.0420,-96.6060 (1 km frame), 44.0393,-96.6065 (320 m frame) and 44.040,-96.606 (4 km frame); all three images rendered. The RV lot is a paved lot on mown upland grass south of the casino on the south edge of Flandreau, with no water in the 1 km frame. The Big Sioux River's nearest bend is ~0.9 km west/northwest across fields and town, and the town's wastewater lagoons ~0.6 km southwest -> not waterfront.

fees.note: Fall/winter (Oct 1-Apr 30) $25 Sun-Thu, $35 Fri-Sat; spring/summer (May 1-Sep 30) $35 Sun-Thu, $45 Fri-Sat; plus tax. A refundable key deposit is required ($25 summer, $5 winter). Discounts available, but not on fall/winter nights.

season_source: Operator rate pages: spring/summer 'May 1-September 30' (live, read 2026-11-22) and fall/winter 'October 1-April 30' (https://web.archive.org/web/20260123114931/https://www.royalrivercasino.com/entertainment/rv-lot-fall-winter-specials, captured 2026-01-23, read 2026-11-22) together cover the whole year with full hookups.
flags: Casino-lot question (the lead's test): it is a separate, purpose-built paved RV lot with full hookups, posted rates and a 28-day cap, not a parking allowance in the casino lot, so added on the Dakota Sioux 14583 / Prairie Knights 5948 precedent. It is still an all-paved lot with no grass or shade; the operator itself calls it the 'RV Lot'.
Quality signals are weak but below the drop threshold: RV Life 2* over 7 reviews (last 2023-11); Google 3.9 over 2,178 belongs to the shared casino+hotel listing, not the RV park.

The old royalrivercasino.com/rv-park page now 302s to the home page (the 'Book Now' button under RV Park on /book-your-stay points there); the live rate page is under /entertainment/. The fall/winter rate page is gone from the live site (its URL now serves an event page) and is cited from Wayback 2026-01-23, so year-round operation rests on that capture. No online booking engine: reservations by phone, check in at the hotel desk.
Phone: 877-912-5825 (1.877.912.LUCK) is the only number on the operator site; Google gives the casino's local 605-997-3746.

RoverPass listing (roverpass.com/c/royal-river-casino-rv-park-flandreau-sd) is unclaimed ('Claim my Campground' under the title, updated 11/15/2024) - not used as a channel. Hipcamp shows 'coming soon'.
Pin on the centre of the paved RV lot (RV Life's 44.03988,-96.6062 sits on the road at its north end; Google's point is the casino building).
